# Connection Planning Functions

Builds native Contracts channels, handlers, embedded processing and initial state from the exact configured clause. Generated handlers evaluate the connection and action declarations in their configured order.

A named `conditionGroups` entry declares `actions` from the exact type and a common `condition`. The planner combines all matching groups with the individual `parameters.conditions` check. Failure follows the ordinary action guard before preflight and effects. A group naming an unknown action fails planning. A group with an empty action list applies to no actions. An applicable group without a condition fails the action guard.

`connectionWithProfile` expands a connection's named profile before ordinary connection planning. The name must be nonempty text without dot, slash or tilde. Profiles can supply `params` and `when`. The planner rejects a local `params` or `when` when a profile is used, unknown profile names, and unsupported profile fields.
